facts.fact: 西德妮在纽敦公共图书馆看线上课，窗外飘着细雪，肘边的热可可已经凉了。
facts.anchor: little drifts of snow dancing past the windows

facts.fact: 热可可是玛莎给的，她叮嘱西德妮别在键盘上方喝。
facts.anchor: courtesy of Martha, who warned her not to drink it over the keyboard

facts.fact: 米奇说，西德妮能杀死伊莱，只因有人设计出能压制 EO 能力的配方。
facts.anchor: Sydney had only been able to kill Eli because someone had designed a formula that could suspend an EO’s powers

facts.fact: 维克多教过她一句话：危险的东西也可以有用。
facts.anchor: But if Victor had taught her anything, it was that dangerous things could be useful.

facts.fact: 林子里突然响起枪声，又响又近，她本能拐弯，差点撞上树。
facts.anchor: A gun went off, too loud, too close.

facts.fact: 她看见一头侧躺的雄鹿，身上还冒着热气，眼睛睁着，已经死了。
facts.anchor: The stag lay on its side, heat still rising off its body, even though its eyes were open.

facts.fact: 鹿刚死不久，生命仍在皮毛下嗡鸣，她抓住那根线把野兽拉了回来。
facts.anchor: Its death was so recent, the life was still right there, humming beneath the surface.

facts.fact: 第二个猎人按下同伴的枪口，说差点打中她。
她蹬车回木屋，听见第二声枪响，感到那根脆弱的线在身后碎成灰。
facts.anchor: felt the brittle thread crumble back to ashes in her wake
